Choose one Geometry Guardian problem. State the geometric fact you used and explain your reasoning.
questions.modelAnswer: For the ladder problem, I used the Baudhayana–Pythagoras theorem because the wall and ground make a right angle and the ladder is the hypotenuse. h² = 13² − 5² = 169 − 25 = 144, so h = 12 m. It makes sense because 12 m is less than the ladder's length.
